outcomes.target: HTTP handler (21 routes, authenticated and not, 20k requests): never 500, always JSON, never leaks stack text (status mix {"200":34354,"201":6385,"400":61328,"401":53993,"404":23827,"409":2235,"429":17878}; caller still authenticated afterwards: true)
validateLedgerRecord: arbitrary and mutated records only ever return or throw AllowListError
validateEnvelope: arbitrary envelopes only return or throw AllowListError; accepted records have no extra keys
checkLabel never accepts URLs, e-mail, credentials, IPv4 or control characters
seal/open round trip for arbitrary JSON values
any mutated ciphertext/nonce, or different AAD binding or key, fails to open
unpad never reads out of bounds on arbitrary bytes (throws or returns a slice)
verify() returns false (never throws) for arbitrary key/message/signature
decryptBackup rejects arbitrary blobs without hanging
wrapAccountKey/unwrapAccountKey round trip; any other binding or key fails
enrollmentTag: different secret or inputs give different tags
validatePushEndpoint: anything accepted is https, no credentials/port, and its parsed host is an allowed push host or subdomain
validatePushKeys / QuietHours / Kinds only throw PushValidationError; inQuietHours total over all numbers
SyncClient.sync()/pull() against arbitrary server replies: no TypeError/RangeError, state stays loadable and JSON-serialisable
ledger merge: applying the same records in any order (and twice) gives the same effective ledger
renderView: arbitrary view contents produce only allowed tags/attributes and string text (no markup passes through)
service worker push handler: any payload (JSON, __proto__, garbage) shows only one of the two fixed notifications
